label: sparse, weak; often the step after input c (t>=3)
explanation: Extremely sparse (0.015% of steps), weak magnitude (max 0.21). Never fires at t<3. About half of activation mass is at the step right after a c input (prev_tok c, lift 17.7x), with o and digit 3 as weaker previous tokens; in_tok i/m/g/f/x enriched; tends to occur at the last original positions or near the end of the copy phase. But every token-level predicate tried has precision under 2.5%: c followed by these tokens is very common and almost always silent, so the feature depends on some hidden-state combination that the token history does not capture. Never fires on incorrect-copy sequences (only 64 such steps exist, so this is weak evidence). No coherent predicate found.
